SELECT category, brand
FROM (
    SELECT 
        dp.category,
        dp.brand,
        SUM(fo.order_amount) AS total_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dp.category ORDER BY SUM(fo.order_amount) DESC) AS rn
    FROM dim_product dp
    INNER JOIN fact_order fo ON dp.product_id = fo.product_id
    WHERE fo.date_id >= 20250101 AND fo.date_id <= 20251231
    GROUP BY dp.category, dp.brand
) ranked
WHERE rn = 1

SELECT d.quarter AS 季度, p.brand AS 品牌, SUM(f.order_quantity) AS 销量
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE d.year = 2025
GROUP BY d.quarter, p.brand
ORDER BY d.quarter, p.brand

SELECT category, SUM(daily_quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM dws_order_daily
WHERE stat_date >= 20250101 AND stat_date <= 20250930
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY SUM(daily_sales) DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT SUM(t2.order_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order t2
JOIN dim_customer t1 ON t2.customer_id = t1.customer_id
JOIN dim_region t3 ON t2.region_id = t3.region_id
JOIN dim_product t4 ON t2.product_id = t4.product_id
JOIN dim_date t5 ON t2.date_id = t5.date_id
WHERE t1.gender = '女'
  AND t3.region_name = '华南'
  AND t4.category = '手机数码'
  AND t5.date_id >= 20250101
  AND t5.date_id <= 20251231

SELECT dc.member_level AS 会员等级, AVG(fo.order_amount) AS 平均订单金额
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_customer dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id
WHERE fo.date_id >= 20250101 AND fo.date_id <= 20251231
GROUP BY dc.member_level

SELECT 
  YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(date_id)) AS year,
  MONTH(FROM_UNIXTIME(date_id)) AS month,
  SUM(order_amount) AS monthly_sales,
  LAG(SUM(order_amount)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(date_id)), MONTH(FROM_UNIXTIME(date_id))) AS prev_monthly_sales,
  SUM(order_amount) - LAG(SUM(order_amount)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(date_id)), MONTH(FROM_UNIXTIME(date_id))) AS growth_amount
FROM fact_order
WHERE date_id >= 20250101 AND date_id <= 20251231
GROUP BY YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(date_id)), MONTH(FROM_UNIXTIME(date_id))
ORDER BY year, month

SELECT 
  dp.brand AS 品牌,
  SUM(fo.order_amount) / (SELECT SUM(order_amount) FROM fact_order fo2 JOIN dim_date dd2 ON fo2.date_id = dd2.date_id WHERE dd2.year = 2025) AS 销售额占比
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025
GROUP BY dp.brand
ORDER BY 销售额占比 DESC

SELECT 
  dr.province AS 省份,
  SUM(fo.order_amount) / COUNT(*) AS 客单价
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025
GROUP BY dr.province

SELECT dc.customer_name
